entries.text: Fixed infinite recursion when numerically evaluating the `Abs` of a complex number with `evalf` while evaluation is disabled, for example `Abs(1 + I, evaluate=False).evalf()` inside `with evaluate(False)`.

structured_output.reasoning: The diff changes `get_abs` in `sympy/core/evalf.py` to compute the magnitude directly from the evaluated real and imaginary parts. This fixes an infinite recursion in `evalf` of an unevaluated `Abs` under `evaluate(False)`. The old `evalf(abs(N(expr)))` code is long-standing, and nothing links the problem to a post-1.14 change, so I treated it as a bug users have seen. The `.mailmap` change and the test need no entry.

input.reasoning: The diff changes `get_abs` in `sympy/core/evalf.py` to compute the magnitude directly from the evaluated real and imaginary parts. This fixes an infinite recursion in `evalf` of an unevaluated `Abs` under `evaluate(False)`. The old `evalf(abs(N(expr)))` code is long-standing, and nothing links the problem to a post-1.14 change, so I treated it as a bug users have seen. The `.mailmap` change and the test need no entry.
